name: ParametricNoise batch and channel correlation
plain: Pulls every frame (batch item, or the time axis of a 5-D video latent) toward one shared seeded draw by slerp, and separately pulls every channel toward a shared single-channel draw. Drift turns the shared draw into a chain where each frame is slerped from the previous one toward a new draw, so correlation falls off with frame distance. Batch correlation on 5-D video latents goes through a safety guard that by default refuses strong settings; channel correlation is not guarded.
math:
Symbols: x noise; z_i fresh seeded draws; t batch amount; c channel amount; d drift.
Chain: c_0=z_0, c_i=slerp(c_{i−1}, z_i, d) (d=0 gives one shared draw).
x' = slerp(x, c, t) per frame; x'' = slerp(x', broadcast(z_ch), c) per (batch,channel) plane; out = N(x'').

props.params: batch_correlation 0, channel_correlation 0, drift 0, normalize on, video_safety refuse|warn|allow
